# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class EquityBollingerBandBreakoutAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2024, 9, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        # Add SPY with daily resolution.
        self._spy = self.add_equity("SPY")
        # Create BB indicator with 20-period width and 2.0 std devs.
        self._bb = self.bb(self._spy, 20, 2.0, resolution=Resolution.DAILY)
        # Warm up so the strategy can trade from the first bar.
        self.set_warm_up(self._bb.warm_up_period + 1, Resolution.DAILY)

    def on_data(self, data: Slice) -> None:
        # BB bands only trade on their official resolution - daily for this example.
        if self._bb.current.time.hour != 0:
            return
        # Get current BB band values.
        upper = self._bb.upper_band.current.value
        middle = self._bb.middle_band.current.value
        lower = self._bb.lower_band.current.value
        price = self._spy.price
        # Long when price breaks below lower band.
        if not self._spy.invested and price < lower:
            self.set_holdings(self._spy, 1)
        # Cover when price reverts above middle band.
        elif self._spy.invested and price > middle:
            self.liquidate()
